new_events.summary: Iraq's state-owned Oil Tanker Company said it transported 2 million barrels of Iraqi crude aboard a VLCC through the Strait of Hormuz, its first such operation in decades. Reuters noted Iraq had previously secured Iranian permission for Iraqi oil tankers to transit the effectively closed strait.

Reuters reported Iran's rial around 2.688 million per U.S. dollar on the free market, versus 2.632 million the prior day, as state banks began selling up to $2 billion to support the currency. Reuters said the rial had lost more than half its value in a year and inflation exceeded 70%.

economic_energy_updates.summary: Iraq used a state-owned VLCC to move 2 million barrels through Hormuz, increasing SOMO's sale and destination flexibility while passage remained dependent on selective Iranian permission.
The rial fell to a new reported free-market low as the central bank deployed up to $2 billion in support; inflation remained above 70% in the cited Reuters report.
